name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefits: Provides subsidized loans for farming up to 3 lakhs.
steps: Visit the closest cooperative bank or regional rural bank branch.
Collect the Kisan Credit Card application form.
Fill out the application detailing land holding and cropping patterns.
Attach mandatory documents and passport size photographs.
Submit the application to the branch manager for verification and issuance.

name: PM KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of ₹6000 per year.
steps: Visit the official PM KISAN website.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' in the Farmers Corner.
Enter your Aadhaar number and fill the relevant details in the application form.
Upload your land record details verifying ownership.
Submit the form and check your status via 'Beneficiary Status'.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
steps: Log on to the PMFBY online portal.
Click on 'Farmer Corner' to apply for crop insurance yourself or navigate to a CSC center.
Fill in your personal, banking, and land details.
Select the crop sown and calculate premium amount.
Pay the nominal premium online to secure coverage.

name: Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
steps: Register on the Agrimachinery direct benefit transfer portal.
Select the type of agricultural machinery you intend to purchase.
Choose a registered dealer and generate a quotation.
Submit the application with the quotation and Aadhaar validation.
Once approved, purchase the equipment and upload the receipt for direct subsidy deposit.
documents: Quotation of Machinery from Registered Dealer

name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya
benefits: Rainwater harvesting and critical irrigation support during dry spells.
steps: Approach your nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Acquire the Krishi Bhagya application form.
Submit the form outlining your intention to setup a Krishi Honda (farm pond) or polyhouse.
An inspection by the local agricultural officer will follow.
Sanctioned funds are released in phases based on setup progress.
documents: RTC (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops)
Caste Certificate (if claiming high subsidy quota)

name: Karnataka Raitha Suraksha
benefits: Financial assistance to farmers during crop failure.
steps: Visit the local Agricultural Department office in your district.
Submit a claim form following crop destruction (due to natural calamity or pests).
A joint survey will be conducted by agriculture & revenue officials.
Submit your bank and RTC details for verification.
Compensation is directly credited via DBT to your linked bank account.

name: Maharashtra Mahatma Jotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti
benefits: Debt relief for farmers facing severe financial crises.
steps: Check your name in the beneficiary list maintained at your local Gram Panchayat.
Visit the Aaple Sarkar Maha-e-Seva Kendra or bank branch with your Aadhaar card.
Complete the biometric authentication process.
Once authenticated, the loan waiver amount is directly credited to your loan account.
Collect the 'No-Dues Certificate' from your bank.
documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account

name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
benefits: Investment support for agriculture and horticulture crops by way of a grant of ₹5,000 per acre per farmer.
steps: Ensure your land ownership details are digitally updated on the Dharani portal.
Submit a copy of your Pattadar Passbook to the Village Revenue Officer (VRO).
Provide your Aadhaar and bank details for validation.
The Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) will verify your crop details.
Funds are directly deposited into your account prior to the Kharif / Rabi seasons.

name: KALIA Scheme
benefits: Financial assistance to cultivators, landless agricultural laborers, and vulnerable agricultural households.
steps: Visit the official KALIA portal and access the Online Grievance / Application form.
Select 'New Application' and fill in your Aadhaar details.
Fill the comprehensive form declaring your status as an active cultivator or landless laborer.
Upload necessary KYC details carefully.
Approval is confirmed via SMS, and funds are disbursed direct-to-bank.

name: Delhi Free Spoken English Course
benefits: Provides free comprehensive spoken English lessons for youth to enhance employability.
steps: Visit the official Delhi DSEU portal.
Register with your mobile number and Aadhaar.
Submit proof of residence and prior education certificates.
Wait for batches to be allotted by the nearest coaching center.
Attend the induction session.

name: Tamil Nadu Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam
benefits: Doorstep healthcare services ensuring medical access to isolated households.
steps: Identify the nearest designated Public Health Center (PHC).
Register via the local health worker or field activist.
Health workers will conduct an initial screening at your doorstep.
Medicines for chronic conditions are delivered directly.
Follow up with regular tele-consultation when required.

name: Gujarat Vhali Dikri Yojana
benefits: Financial assistance to families for the education and marriage of the girl child.
steps: Fill up the application form at the nearest Anganwadi center or Women/Child block office.
Attach birth certificate of the girl child and parents' identity records.
Submit an income certificate verifying annual family earnings constraints.
Upon verification, funds are scheduled for release at age milestones.
Bank accounts must be actively linked with Aadhaar.

name: PM KUSUM Scheme
benefits: Subsidies for setting up solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants.
steps: Visit your respective state's renewable energy agency portal.
Apply online under Component B for standalone solar agriculture pumps.
Deposit the required farmer-share of the cost via demand draft or online payment.
The agency will align a registered vendor for installation.
The system will be commissioned on your farm post-installation inspection.
documents: Declaration stating lack of electricity connection on farm

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefits: Pan-India electronic trading portal linking APMCs.
steps: Register as a Farmer on the e-NAM portal or mobile app.
Provide KYC details and Bank account info for payment integration.
Bring your produce to the nearest connected APMC mandi.
Get your produce quality assayed, which generates continuous online bids.
Accept the highest online bid and receive the payment directly to your bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat PMJAY
steps: Visit pmjay.gov.in to verify your eligibility via mobile number.
Visit any empaneled hospital or nearest Common Service Center (CSC).
Submit identification for E-KYC.
Get your PMJAY e-card printed.
Present the e-card during hospitalization for cashless treatment.

name: MUDRA Yojana
steps: Prepare your business plan.
Visit authorized Banks, NBFCs or MFIs.
Complete the MUDRA loan application under Shishu, Kishore or Tarun category.
Submit required KYCs and projected business financials.
Once approved, loans are disbursed to an active business account.
documents: Quotations for machinery/items to be purchased
